source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
From [battle round 2](vsdata:core-rule/the-battle-round) on, as [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) begins, if you picked fewer **GREY KNIGHTS** units than the most [Gate of Infinity](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.gate-of-infinity) allows as your opponent's last turn ended, you can pick a **GREY KNIGHTS** unit of yours on the battlefield that Gate of Infinity could have picked. That unit leaves the battlefield and goes into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**.

So the unit can hold its place through [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), then go into Strategic Reserves and be set up somewhere else in your Reinforcements step.

trigger.requires: selected fewer than the Gate of Infinity maximum at end of previous opponent turn

effect.procedure: remove then place in Strategic Reserves
